name: Dumbbell bench press
notes: Flat dumbbell press. Record the load of one dumbbell.

guide.setup: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, feet planted, and shoulder blades pulled together.
guide.execution: Lower the dumbbells to either side of the lower chest, then press them up until the arms are straight.
guide.cues: Keep the upper back anchored. Use a comfortable elbow angle. Press evenly.
guide.mistakes: Losing control at the bottom; flaring elbows; bouncing; lifting the hips.

images.caption: Dumbbells pressed above the chest with shoulder blades set on the bench.
